calibration.scope: This instrument is LEXICAL only (token-set Jaccard over candidate text). A full semantic rewrite is NOT detectable by this instrument: it lands in the same score band as a genuinely distinct pair. Near-duplicate verdicts apply only to lexical similarity (exact rename, vocabulary-retaining paraphrase, one-parameter fork). They are not mechanism identity and must not be read as such.
calibration.threshold_rule: midpoint between min(exact_rename, paraphrase, one_parameter_fork) and max(full_rewrite, known_distinct). Pairs at or above the threshold are lexical near-duplicates. Pairs below it are not findings of this instrument, including full semantic rewrites.

evidence.claim: Planted exact-rename, paraphrase, and one-parameter-fork mutants land in a high numeric band [0.942857, 1.0]; planted full-rewrite and known-distinct mutants land in a low numeric band [0.0, 0.211538]. Gap=0.731319.

Known-distinct control seed-harbor-review-gate vs distinct-kiln-sign-pipeline scores jaccard=0.211538, which is in the low band (max 0.211538) and below the lexical threshold 0.577198. A full rewrite of the seed lands in the same low band: this instrument cannot detect it.

instrument.formula: |A ∩ B| / |A ∪ B| over lowercase [a-z0-9]+ token sets
instrument.name: token-set-jaccard

question_or_target: Implement a token-Jaccard near-duplicate scan over candidate text, with sensitivity calibrated by planted mutants (exact rename, paraphrase, one-parameter fork, full rewrite). The report states the numeric band each mutant class lands in, and scopes the verdict to LEXICAL similarity: a full semantic rewrite is NOT detectable by this instrument.
